name: ChakuChaku - JLPT N5 & N4
subtitle: Japanese in context
shortDescription: Japanese in context: N5/N4 grammar, stories, vocabulary and spaced repetition.
promotionalText: Explore N5 and N4 Japanese through short stories, meaningful sentences and real words. Practise grammar, vocabulary, conjugation and kana with spaced repetition.
description:
Learn Japanese in context, from your first kana to JLPT N5 and N4.

ChakuChaku connects grammar, vocabulary, conjugation and reading through meaningful Japanese sentences and real words. Short practice sessions and spaced repetition help you build knowledge you can use.

GRAMMAR IN COMPLETE SENTENCES
Study grammar through Japanese sentences. Spaced repetition follows individual grammar points, bringing them back in different contexts while giving you more practice with vocabulary and conjugation.

SHORT STORIES, BIGGER UNDERSTANDING
Read N5 and N4 stories about everyday life, travel, hobbies and time with friends. Use furigana, word meanings and sentence audio when you need support, then check your understanding with questions in English or French. Story sentences also appear in grammar practice.

BUILD YOUR FOUNDATIONS
- Learn hiragana and katakana inside real words
- Study vocabulary in both directions
- Learn kanji through readings, words and contextual examples
- Practise verb and adjective conjugation
- Work through N5 and N4 grammar at your own pace

REVIEW WHAT NEEDS ATTENTION
Spaced repetition tracks grammar points, words, kanji, kana and conjugation forms individually. A mixed daily review brings together the material that is due.

READ AND LISTEN WITH SUPPORT
Listen to Japanese word and sentence recordings. Adaptive furigana can hide readings for kanji you already know, helping you move towards more independent reading.

SEE YOUR PROGRESS
Detailed statistics distinguish material you have encountered, are learning, are consolidating and have retained over longer intervals. Choose English or French for explanations and practice.

YOUR PROGRESS, ON YOUR DEVICE
ChakuChaku is free to use, works offline and requires no account. There are no ads. Export and import your progress whenever you choose. Optional AI autocorrection can be enabled with your own OpenAI API key.

Study steadily. Improve チャクチャク: step by step.
